title: Blood Lipid-lowering Effect of Brown Alga Ecklonia Cava
brief_summary: The investigators performed a 12-week, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled human trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Ecklonia cava extract on hyperlipidemia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Mild hypercholesterolemic subjects(≥200mg/dL of total cholesterol or ≥110mg/dL of LDL-cholesterol)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Self-reported pregnancy, lactation
* Prevalent heart disease, cancer, renal disorder, or diabetes mellitus, and use of lipid-lowering drugs
